mansion-gates.promptBlock: Grey stone mansion with a steep slate roof and chimneys, seen through a pair of tall black wrought-iron gates that stand open on stone gateposts. Dusk sky, orange-gold sun on the facade, gravel drive, clipped hedges. Camera outside the gates looking in.
mansion-gates.preserve: the same grey stone mansion, open black iron gates, dusk orange light, gravel drive

mansion-foyer.promptBlock: Grand foyer: cream paneled walls, white marble fireplace, large gold-framed oil portrait of four people hanging above the mantel, black-and-white diamond marble floor, warm wall sconces. Interior, no windows in frame.
mansion-foyer.preserve: the same cream paneled foyer, white fireplace, gold-framed family portrait, black-and-white marble floor, warm sconces

mansion-study.promptBlock: Wood-paneled study: floor-to-ceiling dark mahogany bookshelves packed with leather-bound books, green glass banker's lamp on a polished mahogany desk, warm tungsten lamp light, no windows in frame.
mansion-study.preserve: the same mahogany bookshelves, green banker's lamp, polished desk, warm tungsten light

scenes.imagePrompt: Elena stands between the open gates, body facing the house, chin lifted, eyes on the upper facade, hands at her sides, lips slightly parted, not looking at camera.
scenes.videoPrompt: Elena looks up slowly toward the mansion filling the upper frame. She says, "Ten years." She pauses, then continues, "Time to finish this." Camera static. Outdoor wind, a distant gate creak, no music.

scenes.imagePrompt: Medium shot. Elena stands in front of the mantel, three-quarter to camera, chin lifted, eyes on the painted faces in the portrait, hands at her sides, lips slightly parted, not looking at camera. The gold-framed portrait hangs above her.
scenes.videoPrompt: Elena tilts her head slightly toward the portrait. She says, "You should have told me." Cut. She pulls a sealed cream envelope from behind the lower-right of the gold frame and glances at it. She murmurs, "What is this." Cut. She unfolds the letter and reads. She says, "He sold the house." She pauses, then continues, "They all knew." Camera slow push-in. Room echo, paper sliding, no music.

scenes.imagePrompt: Medium shot. Elena sits at the desk, torso facing an open leather ledger already in both hands on the desktop, eyes on the page, not looking at camera, lips slightly parted. Green banker's lamp at screen-right, bookshelves behind her.
scenes.videoPrompt: Elena's finger traces one line in the ledger. She says, "His sale." She pauses, then continues, "My proof." Cut. She freezes, eyes on a closed wooden door at screen-left, then slips the ledger into her coat and looks at the camera. She whispers, "I can keep secrets too." Camera static. A page settling, a distant footstep, fabric rustle, quiet room tone, no music.
